name: Public Transport (PTV)
description: Next departures from a PTV stop (train / tram / bus / V-Line / night bus). Live data via the PTV Timetable API v3. Register at https://www.ptv.vic.gov.au/footer/data-and-reporting/datasets/ptv-timetable-api/ to receive a developer ID and signing key, then paste them into Settings → Plugins → Public Transport. Pick stop_id + route_type per cell.

cell_options.name: stop_id
cell_options.label: Stop ID (numeric, from the PTV API)
